query:
WITH previous AS (
            SELECT owner, "deletedAt", "projectId"
            FROM "Document"
            WHERE id = $1
            FOR UPDATE
        )
        UPDATE "Document" document
        SET "deletedAt" = NULL
        FROM previous
        WHERE document.id = $1
        RETURNING document.owner AS owner,
            previous."projectId" AS project_id,
            previous."deletedAt" IS NOT NULL AS "actually_restored!"
